# Costs

<!-- Generated by `rake docs` from the primitive registry. Do not edit. -->

## discard_self

Discard the card the ability belongs to (it goes from your hand to your graveyard). An ability with this cost is activated from your hand.

Rules: CR 701.9a, CR 602.2b, CR 113.6m, CR 118.3

```json
"discard_self"
```

## mana

Pay mana as part of an activation. Paid during the activation by spending mana from your pool, tapping sources one at a time.

Rules: CR 601.2g, CR 601.2h, CR 602.2b

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `(value)` | mana cost string, e.g. "{1}{R}" |

```json
{
  "mana": "{1}{R}"
}
```

## sacrifice

Sacrifice the permanent the ability belongs to (it goes to its owner's graveyard).

Rules: CR 701.21a, CR 602.2b, CR 118.3

```json
"sacrifice"
```

## tap

{T} — tap the permanent the ability belongs to. Requires it to be untapped.

Rules: CR 107.5, CR 602.5a

```json
"tap"
```

## tap_another_creature

Tap another untapped creature you control, chosen while activating. A creature that came under your control this turn can be tapped this way.

Rules: CR 702.184a, CR 601.2h, CR 602.2b, CR 302.6

```json
"tap_another_creature"
```
